{{Quote|Get up there, trooper!|Rex orders Draa to destroy a group of droidekas on Geonosis|<ref name="Weapons Factory" />}}
'''Draa''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Draa participated in the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]], under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], after the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] broke free from the Republic control that had been established on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] since the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|beginning]] of the Clone Wars. Draa took part in the attack on a [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]] and, along with most of the Republic forces there, distracted the Separatist [[Droid/Legends|droids]] as two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] infiltrated the foundry to destroy the main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]]. Although Draa and the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] faced heavy opposition from enemy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tanks]], the foundry was destroyed and the Republic later won the battle.

==Biography==
Draa, a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]].<ref name="SWE" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the events of "[[Landing at Point Rain]]" to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], site of the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the Clone Wars, once again became a problem for the Republic as [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|droid foundries]] manned by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] resumed producing [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. Determined to stop the production of these battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]], a Republic attack force arrived in the [[Geonosis system/Legends|Geonosis system]]. After the Republic forces saw the destruction of the Geonosian [[Geonosis ray shield generator/Legends|Ray Shield Fortress]] protecting the [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|primary droid foundry]],<ref name="Landing at Point Rain">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> Draa and other [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]], who had arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to reinforce the attack force that would strike for the foundry, were dispatched in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Republic gunships]] to help the attack force. Led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]], Draa, and fellow trooper [[Buzz/Legends|Buzz]], disembarked from the [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]], ''[[Dooku Boot/Legends|Dooku Boot]]''.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

[[File:Draa-Dooku_boot.png|thumb|left|210px|Draa exits ''Dooku Boot'' along with his Jedi commanders and fellow troopers.]]
Unduli, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], respectively, met and established a plan. It was decided that the main Republic force, which included Draa, would distract the enemy with a frontal assault, while the Padawans infiltrated the foundry to destroy its [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] with [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. As planned, Draa and the [[Troop/Legends|troops]], led by Unduli and Skywalker, marched to attack the droid factory head-on via a bridge in an effort to distract the enemy as the Padawans completed their mission. Draa and the troops faced heavy opposition as ten [[Garrison/Legends|garrisons]] of droids and [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] armed with [[Sonic blaster/Legends|sonic blasters]] engaged them. When a detachment of [[Personal energy shield/Legends|shield-equipped]] [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] arrived to reinforce the droid forces, Draa was called forward by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] to deal with the destroyers. Draa used a [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] to destroy the first rank of droidekas, while [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass driver]] blasts from the supporting Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] obliterated the rest.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

When Confederate experimental [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tanks]] arrived to support the droid forces, Draa and the clone forces were forced to fall back after they discovered the [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] were [[Ray shield/Legends|ray-shielded]], rendering the clones' [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]]-class [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|AV-7 Antivehicle Cannons]] useless against the tanks. To help Draa and the clones, Unduli and Skywalker eliminated the tanks by destroying the bridge they were crossing, but the effort left the Jedi stranded on the other side of the bridge, facing heavy droid opposition. Watching from the opposite side of the canyon that the bridge had spanned, Draa observed the foundry collapse, due to the destruction of its reactor by the Padawans. Draa and the troops took cover, as the dust wave, created by the factory's demise, swept toward them. As the dust wave passed, Draa and a detachment of troopers rendezvoused with their Jedi [[Officer/Legends|officers]] on the opposite side of the canyon via a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]].<ref name="Weapons Factory" /> With the main droid resistance eliminated, Republic troops began the task of wiping out small pockets of enemy forces to once again gain control of Geonosis.<ref name="Terror">{{TCW|Legacy of Terror}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
As a clone of Jango Fett, Draa stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" /> Draa was an eager trooper,<ref name="ep guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode206.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Weapons Factory}}</ref> and when called forward by CT-7567 to destroy the droidekas, he readily obeyed.<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

==Equipment==
Draa utilized a [[RPS-6 rocket launcher/Legends|RPS-6 rocket launcher]], as well as a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] and [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]]. Draa's helmet sported the [[Color/Legends|green]] markings of the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]].<ref name="Weapons Factory" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Buckle your belts and check your cells, soldiers. We're going in.|Buzz's line that was credited to Draa in the script of the episode.|audio=BuckleYourBelts-WF.flac|<ref name="ep guide" />}}
Draa first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] episode "[[Weapons Factory]]." Though Draa was unnamed in the script, Draa's name was first revealed in the episode's accompanying [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|episode guide]] on [[StarWars.com]]. According to the script for "Weapons Factory," Draa was the one who was supposed to say the "Buckle your belts&hellip;" line. However, the line was given to clone trooper Buzz in the actual episode.<ref name="ep guide" />

The toy company [[Hasbro]] released a minifigure of Draa that included all three weapons he was seen with in "Weapons Factory." On the back of Draa's figure card, the text incorrectly called the trooper's DC-15S carbine a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2010 Basic Figure|pack=#35: Clone Trooper Draa|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW35-Draa.asp}}</ref> The [[Sony]] Online Entertainment game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] also released a clone trooper outfit of Draa on [[May 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="CWA">{{TCWA|Clone trooper outfit}}</ref>
